PENDING.ALLOWED: valid authenticated sensitive Allow, exact target, now<=expiresAt, receipt minted
PENDING.DENIED: valid decision; sensitive requires human; zero receipt
PENDING.EXPIRED: independent host timer or authenticated overdue admission/sync; now>expiresAt
PENDING.CANCELLED: owner AbortSignal, host shutdown/drain, setup/broadcast failure, or receipt failure

deadline_authentication: Untrusted response does not perform state transitions. Expired-read alone confers no permission to expire pending.
restart: All ephemeral state lost; old response UNKNOWN, no inference
